verdict.rationale: Shopify's Checkout MCP documents creating checkout sessions from carts and a complete_checkout tool that will "Submit payment and place the order". Orders can then be read via get_order or webhooks. However, direct completion is limited to trusted Token-tier agents whose token is granted purchase permission; the default path hands the buyer off to the merchant for payment, and escalations force a buyer handoff. Delegated payment credentials are described mainly at the UCP/AP2 spec level rather than as a concrete Shopify flow. missing for 10: self-serve access to agent-completed checkout without a trusted-tier grant, concrete Shopify-side documentation of the delegated payment credential flow (AP2 mandates or payment handler token exchange), hands-on evidence of a completed checkout and confirmed order (the probe stopped at cart creation).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can complete a purchase end-to-end — checkout session, delegated payment credential, confirmed order
